clauses.proposal: Exclude only the three named shared host infrastructure roles from job accounting; report them as external nonzero costs. This does not amend protected-storage safety.

Kernel CPU bandwidth control plus cumulative cgroup user+system observation and early stop, not a zero-overshoot lifetime CPU hard cap. Include controller and collector through capture/cleanup. An observed final CPU over nominal budget rejects the run; missing counters are UNKNOWN. No invented finite worst-case scheduler delay.

Pre-armed independent manager deadline plus early controller stop, with measured activation-to-final-cleanup wall. Standard non-realtime delivery semantics; over nominal wall rejects the run, missing endpoints UNKNOWN. RuntimeMaxSec alone does not cover the whole lifecycle.

Linux memory.max and memory.swap.max=0 hierarchical semantics, including documented possible temporary memory.max overshoot. Retain peak/events and any OOM failure. Do not rename this a literal zero-transient-overshoot guarantee.

Existing P1-safe independent disposable whole-device and reviewed same-instance administrative boundary, fixed allocated blocks/inodes, metadata/journal/failure reserve. No shared-root partition, C-drive VHD, loop or logical slot substitution. All work/private/persistent job writes share the original disk ceiling.

Separate collector from worker/controller death domains while retaining one aggregate pool and existing 32KiB slots. Reserve before work, protected UID/FD boundary, raw cgroup capture before removal. Outer collector/host loss leaves only committed checkpoints and UNKNOWN; power-loss survival is not assumed.

Whole-job membership and independent manager cleanup after worker/controller loss; verify empty cgroup and no surviving owned descendants before accepting completion. Do not treat disappearance of a unit as evidence of cleanup.

After separate human acceptance of every clause, concrete provisioning and independently authorized normal/failure kernel tests are still required. A source/CI PASS cannot authorize S4, BUILD_ONLY or physics and cannot set original A FULL true.
